answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each agent to a Wesolowski VDF requiring a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with every result dependent on the preceding one. An attacker can instantiate many nominal clones, but GPUs cannot parallelize the dependency depth or eliminate each clone’s delay; additional hardware only repeats the work. Thus canyon, zephyr, and juniper identities encounter a strict physical throughput bottleneck, making Sybil expansion costly and time-limited.
